{{Quote|I don't remember them, actually. They died at the sacking of Coruscant, at Sith hands.|Ashara Zavros, on her parents|<ref name="Masters" />}}
'''Rolend Zavros'''<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> was a [[Togruta/Legends|Togruta]]<ref name="Masters" /> [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]]<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the [[Great Galactic War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="Masters" /> Rolend was [[Marriage/Legends|married]] to a fellow Togruta [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Knight named [[Yanila Zavros|Yanila]],<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> and around [[3662 BBY]],<ref name="Date">The events of Act II of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' occur around [[3642 BBY]] per the reasoning [[Template:TOR_dates/2|here]]. ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]'' states that [[Ashara Zavros]] is twenty [[Standard year/Legends|years]] old when the player meets her, which occurs in Act II; thus, Zavros must have been [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] around [[3662 BBY]].</ref> the two [[Reproduction/Legends|had]] a daughter they named [[Ashara Zavros|Ashara]], though their duties in the ongoing war often prevented the two from spending much [[Time/Legends|time]] with their daughter as she grew up on the Republic [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="Encyclopedia" />

In [[3653 BBY]], just as Ashara began showing signs of the [[Force-sensitive/Legends|strength in the Force]] common to the [[Zavros family]],<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> Rolend and Yanila were present on Coruscant when the Sith Empire [[Sacking of Coruscant|sacked]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. Both Jedi were [[Death/Legends|killed]] defending the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] from [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] invaders,<ref name="Masters" /> leaving Ashara to be adopted by the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] [[Ryen]] and [[Ocera]].<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> Ashara later told her [[Sith Master/Legends|Sith Master]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Darth Nox|Kallig]] that she had very few memories of her parents as a result.<ref name="Masters" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Dear Ashara. We're glad to hear you're happy and well. We're very proud that you've become a Jedi. Asher is nearly sixteen and plans to join Republic Special Forces. Love, Mom and Dad.|The contradictory letter|<ref name="Fear and Longing">{{TORcite|type=conversation|Ashara Zavros|Fear and Longing}}</ref>}}
Rolend Zavros was first mentioned in conversations with the [[Sith Inquisitor]] companion Ashara Zavros in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]],<ref name="Masters" /> though they were not named until the [[2012]] reference guide ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]'', which was published by [[Dorling Kindersley]].<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> In ''The Old Republic'', the conversation "Masters" establishes that Zavros's parents died in the Sacking of Coruscant,<ref name="Masters" /> which is backed up by ''The Old Republic Encyclopedia''.<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> However, in the conversation "Fear and Longing," which occurs if the player character is not romancing Zavros, she reads a letter from her parents and says that they are still alive, though she has not seen them in fifteen years. This article assumes that the latter conversation is in error.<ref name="Fear and Longing" />
